toxicity.Notes: Acute toxicity, section 2.4.1 and section 3.2.9: groups of six adult female Swiss albino mice were given a single i.p. injection of MnNG at different concentrations, or vehicle, or left untreated, and the LD50 was found to be 100 mg/kg. The individual doses, the mortality at each of them and the calculation method are not reported, so those fields stay empty; the paper states only the resulting value. The follow-up toxicological work used one tenth and one seventh of that LD50, 10 and 15 mg/kg as a single i.p. injection, and found no toxic symptoms and no mortality at either dose after 72 h, and the discussion adds that 14 days of treatment produced no systemic toxicity; those are blood counts, liver and kidney enzymes and spleen and bone marrow cells, which belong to the separate Organ toxicity pass. The anticancer work is doxorubicin-sensitive and doxorubicin-resistant Ehrlich ascites carcinoma scored by mean survival time and T/C (175.32 % and 190.37 % for EAC/S, 246.67 % and 289.05 % for EAC/Dox at 10 and 15 mg/kg), with ascitic fluid volume and packed cell volume alongside; there is no solid tumour and no tumour growth inhibition, so no main row.
